errors.text_span: illustrates the accuracy percentages of four different audio-language models – Gwen2-Audio-Instructor, Audio2-Reasoner, Gwen2-Omni, and MMAR
errors.evidence: The chart shows three models on the x-axis, not four. MMAR is a dataset represented by the purple bars, not a model.
The description fails to mention that this is a grouped bar chart, where each model on the x-axis has two bars (MMAU and MMAR). This is a critical structural aspect of the chart.
The model names are incorrect. The chart shows 'Qwen2-Audio-Instruct', 'Audio-Reasoner', and 'Qwen-2.5-Omni'.
